sample_unit: patient medical queries to conversational LLMs (plus 11 simulated ambient scribe patient visits)

links.outcome: Errors in ambient digital scribe notes, categorised by type and clinical significance
links.effect: 66 errors across 11 simulated patient visits; omission most common (83% of errors); 55% low and 45% moderate clinical significance.
links.quote: Similarly, in the ADS simulation, we identified 66 errors across 11 patient visits, with omission being the most common (83% of errors).

unlisted_practices: Classification system (taxonomy) for categorising generative AI patient safety errors by input and output stage, error type and clinical significance

screen.reason: The study develops and empirically evaluates a patient safety error classification system (a monitoring/surveillance deployment safeguard) across simulated/offline generative AI tasks (patient-facing LLMs and ambient digital scribes).

primary.practice: safety error classification and monitoring system
